rationale.overall: A matches the REFERENCE’s gel-tube volume and especially its hot vermilion accent glow more closely than B’s cooler, flatter ember.
rationale.material: Both rings share comparable torus shading and speculars, but A’s orange wedge keeps the brighter translucent highlight and saturated red-orange bloom the REFERENCE shows.
rationale.silhouette: Ring weight, gap placement, and wedge shape read as effectively the same between A and B at full size.
rationale.smallsize: At 32px and 16px A’s orange chip stays a hotter high-contrast spark, while B’s lower-chroma accent softens and loses the focal cue.
